cards.back: BCP = overall business continuity; DR = IT processes that restore systems to meet BCP objectives.
Continuously operational, data synchronized, recovery in minutes, highest cost.
Hardware ready, data must be restored, recovery in hours.
Facility only, hardware and data must be installed, recovery in days, lowest cost.
Recovery Point Objective: maximum acceptable data loss, measured backward from the incident.
Recovery Time Objective: maximum acceptable service outage duration.
Mean Time To Repair: average time to repair a failed component.
Mean Time Between Failures: average time between two failures; reliability indicator.
Server RTO 1 hr on a network with RTO 3 hr → effective server RTO = 3 hr.
Load balancing, clustering, autoscaling, high availability (plus multicloud).
Uninterruptible Power Supply: battery backup, short runtime.
Redundant Power Supply: redundant power supply inside a device.
Generator = long runtime; surge protector = protection against power surges.
Copy that cannot be modified even by an administrator: key defense against ransomware.
Failover = switching to the backup site; failback = returning to the primary site.
Simulation = controlled exercise; parallel processing = running on both sites to compare.
Physical isolation and vendor, hardware, and virtualization diversity reduce shared risk.
